s: Im muttar liqrot bammerchatz ubo saip echad: merchatz chadash shello rachatzu bo — muttar liqrot bo, sheen qeriat shem osarto kemo sheoseret bebet hakkisse, lepi shebbet hakkisse hu maus beyoter. Umerchatz yashan, babbayit hachitzon shekkol haomedim sham hem lebushim — muttar liqrot sham qeriat shema ulehitpallel. Ubaemtza sheqqetzat min haomedim sham hem lebushim uqetzatam arummim — yesh sham sheilat shalom, abal lo qeriat shema utepilla vedibre tora apillu beshaa sheen sham adam arom. Abal muttar leharher sham bedibre tora apillu kesheyyesh sham arummim. Umuttar lipsoq sham din, ubilbad shello yomar taamo shel dabar, shezzeh eno ella kemo hirhur bedibre tora shemmechashsheb hattaam belibbo. Vehabbayit happenimi shekkol haomedim sham hem arummim — apillu sheilat shalom asur ki "shalom" hu shemo shel haqqadosh baruk hu, shenneemar: "vayyiqra lo Hashem shalom". Vehu haddin sheasur litten shalom lachabero bimboot hamtunnapot. Veadam sheshshemo shalom — yesh oserin liqrot bishmo ella bilshon (la"z). Veyesh mattirin, kevan sheen mitkavven al inyan hashshalom ella lehazkarat shemo shel oto adam (ubedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel. Veken nohagin). Veasur laanot sham amen, velo leharher beshum dabar shebbiqdushsha. Veim shaal lo adam debar halaka — asur lomar lo en meshibin bammerchatz. Abal babbayit haemtzai muttar lomar lo kak:
